kind: native Herdr pane.read text from the actual ./lab (pinned Pi 1.4.0 + Herdr) in owned pseudo-terminals; not a mockup

captureSource.fixture: owned 127.0.0.1 Bun.serve scripted OpenAI-compatible protocol fixture and a local HTML page; no model inference, provider calls or auth

sanitization: Project path → $PROJECT, state → $STATE, home → $HOME, fixture port → PORT, project basename → PROJECT. The script fails if any /private/, /var/folders, /Users/ or /tmp/ path survives in the .txt captures or the model log. Raw ANSI streams are not published because redraw escapes can split paths; the hostile-control check runs on the raw stream instead (narrowRawStreamHasNoHostileControls).
exercised: ask: allow once (edit), deny (bash; model receives the denial), Esc (denies), deny with note
edits: in-project edit auto-approved, bash still asks, a write to .pi/settings.json asks (agent/VCS config)
auto: launch flag prints the one-line start warning on stdout; edit and bash run with no prompts
/lab-mode auto confirm (Cancel first; Esc keeps the mode) naming what auto skips and that desktop actions still ask
browser fill prompts with origin, element label and masked secret; F30 rows labelled from the per-call record
hostile text at 40 columns; widths 120, 80 and 40
notExercised: Allow for this session in the pty (unit tests only)
relay_send prompt and relay_ack refusal in the pty (unit tests only; the actual Relay model test runs json mode with explicit auto)
edits refusing an out-of-project, symlinked, LAB-state or other sensitive path besides .pi/settings.json in the pty (unit tests only)
the in-Pi auto start notification (the capture is taken after it has gone; unit test only)
stale-ref refusal for a parallel snapshot+fill batch, broken/FIFO mode file, unregistered lab_desktop, registered desktop family (unit tests only; agent-desktop is PR #28)
no-UI denial in Pi json/print mode in the pty (unit tests only)
notes: The (auto) in Pi's footer is Pi's auto-compaction marker, not the LAB mode; the LAB mode is the 'mode: <m> · /lab-mode' status line.
At 40 columns Pi's native select wraps a long option label without indenting it; LAB's own title rows wrap with wrapColumns.
